analysis.summary: The rule flags labeled statements where the label is never referenced by a break or continue statement.
silentShapes: LABEL: outer: inner: { if (cond) break inner; }
analysis.fixDescription: Remove the label and its trailing colon, leaving only the associated statement unchanged.
hazards: Removing a label before a 'var' declaration changes nothing because labels do not affect variable scoping or hoisting.
Removing a label before a block statement does not alter the block's execution or variable scoping.
Removing a label before a loop does not affect the loop's iteration or control flow unless the label was referenced.
Removing a label before a 'switch' statement does not change its behavior as labels do not influence case execution.
Removing a label before a function declaration does not affect hoisting, name binding, or invocation semantics.
Removing a label before a class definition does not impact class creation, inheritance, or instantiation.
If a comment exists between the label and the statement, the autofix is skipped per rule design, so no hazard arises from fix application in those cases.

Removing a label cannot cause the following statement to become a directive prologue entry like 'use strict' because labels cannot precede such directives without being part of a block, and the rule avoids fixing when ambiguity exists.
Labels have no runtime semantics; their removal has no side effect on evaluation order, expression results, or state changes.
Label removal does not affect automatic semicolon insertion (ASI) because labels are not expressions and do not participate in ASI resolution.

results.hazard: Removing a label from a `var` declaration can cause early reference errors due to hoisting when combined with block-scoped redeclarations.

results.title: Name Collision Across Scopes After Move
results.hazard: Label removal exposes a previously shadowed variable, causing unintended capture in nested scopes.

results.title: Comment Between Label and Statement - Near Miss
results.hazard: If a comment exists between label and statement, autofix is skipped — no behavioral change occurs.

results.title: ASI Unaffected by Label Removal
results.hazard: Labels do not influence Automatic Semicolon Insertion; removing them doesn't change statement boundaries.

results.title: Null/Undefined Distinction and Optional Chaining
results.hazard: Label removal in a block containing optional chaining preserves null/undefined semantics; misbehavior would alter short-circuit.

results.title: This Binding: Arrow vs Function
results.hazard: Label removal before a function expression does not alter `this` binding; arrow functions remain lexically bound.

results.title: Var Declaration Scoping Unaffected by Label Removal
results.hazard: Label removal does not affect variable hoisting or scoping — `var` remains function-scoped regardless of label presence.

results.title: Numeric/String Coercion: + vs Template Literal
results.hazard: Label removal before an expression involving `+` or template literals does not alter coercion behavior.
